main_problems: No factual errors were found. One field is outdated: the ACC admin_region still says 광주광역시, while the ACC official page now uses 전남광주통합특별시.
Five records (Jeondeungsa, Taehwagang, ACC, Yonggungsa, Ganjeolgot) leave fees, hours and reservation null, even though the cited official pages give hours, parking and closing days.
Weak or off-topic sources: Jeondeungsa cites a VISITKOREA Incheon food article, and Yonggungsa cites a drama filming-tour page. The Yonggungsa official site was down (503).
The Gyeongju hours (09:00-22:00) come from a city page last updated in Feb 2023, so they may be stale.
Public transport access, time needed, and parking are missing from most records; only Changdeokgung includes transit.
Unverifiable: riverside closures after rain (Ulsan), Nurimaru operating days, and the lighthouse museum closing day (third-party sources only).
